newsitem.title: MEXICO: Telmex in interconnection pact with three firms.
newsitem.headline: Telmex in interconnection pact with three firms.

text.p: Telefonos de Mexico (Telmex) said on Monday it has reached interconnection agreements with three new long-distance carriers.
The deals were reached with Marca-Tel SA de CV, Miditel SA de CV and Investcom SA de CV, Telmex said in a report to the Mexican stock exchange.

The three firms are among a host of new companies getting ready to compete with Telmex for long-distance service. The deals allow the new firms to hook up to Telmex's existing network in exchange for a fee.
Telmex was a legal monopoly until competitors were allowed to service corporate clients beginning in August. The competition for retail clients begins on January 1, 1997.
